name: Virginia
modelFitReason: Progressive brackets fit; head-of-household standard deduction currently mirrors single pending a dedicated HoH figure.
limits: Head of household standard deduction and personal exemption on this page currently mirror single-filer amounts pending a dedicated HoH figure from Virginia Tax.
Additional age or blindness exemptions of $800 per qualifying exemption are not modeled as separate inputs.
localTaxNote: Virginia counties and cities do not levy a local income tax on wages. This calculator estimates Virginia state income tax only.

notes.text: Virginia's rates are 2% on the first $3,000 of taxable income, 3% up to $5,000, 5% up to $17,000, and 5.75% above $17,000.
The standard deduction is $8,750 for single filers and $17,500 for married couples filing jointly for taxable year 2025 and after.
The standard deduction increase is scheduled to sunset after taxable year 2026, reverting to $3,000 (single) and $6,000 (married filing jointly) unless the law changes.
Each personal or dependent exemption is $930, with an additional $800 for each exemption for age 65 and over or blind.

Head of household brackets on this page match Virginia’s published wage schedule. The standard deduction and personal exemption for head of household currently mirror the single-filer amounts until Virginia Tax publishes a dedicated HoH figure we can verify separately.
